page.layout: One printed page, title page: centred lines of text from top to bottom, with a Hebrew line in red, an engraved vignette with a seal-like device to the right of it, and the imprint at the foot.

main_text.l: Cum Privilegio D. D. Ordinum Hollandiæ & Westfrisiæ.

page.notes: The Hebrew line "סוד בבל רבת" is printed in red and read from right to left. The vignette (a circular laurel-framed engraving of two figures, and a crowned seal-like device with a Latin motto) is not transcribed as text. The words in red (APOCALYPSEOS, DIATRIBÆ, PETRUM VAN DER Aa.) and the underlined HEIDEGGERI are noted for typographic emphasis only. The final line's long s is printed as s in the original; it is rendered here as a plain s per the transcription rules.
